CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFCACHE

Put CFCACHE at the top of a page whose content rarely changes. The first request runs the page normally and saves the finished HTML; later requests for the same URL get the saved copy without running any CFML at all, until the copy is older than TIMEOUT or the cache is flushed.

Category

Output and page processing

Syntax

<CFCACHE ACTION="CACHE/FLUSH/CLIENTCACHE/OPTIMAL"
    DIRECTORY="directory"
    TIMEOUT="date_time"
    EXPIREURL="url"
    PROTOCOL="http://"
    PORT="port"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password">

Attributes

ACTION
Optional, default "CACHE". "CACHE" serves and saves cached copies. "FLUSH" deletes cached copies. CLIENTCACHE and OPTIMAL (browser caching in ColdFusion) are treated like CACHE.
DIRECTORY
Optional. Absolute path of the directory that holds the cached copies. The default is the cache directory of the KoldFusion installation.
TIMEOUT
Optional. A date/time. A cached copy made before this moment is stale and the page is run again. DateAdd("h", -1, Now()) means "no copy older than an hour". Without TIMEOUT a copy never expires.
EXPIREURL
Optional. With ACTION="FLUSH": only flush copies whose URL starts with this text, for example "/CFDOCS/snippets/cfcache.cfm". Without it every copy in DIRECTORY is deleted.
PROTOCOL
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
PORT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
USERNAME
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
PASSWORD
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

Each distinct URL, including its query string, gets its own cached copy, so detail.cfm?id=1 and detail.cfm?id=2 are cached separately. Pages that show session data, personal greetings or form results should not be cached.

A cached copy is only saved when the page finishes normally: pages that fail, redirect with CFLOCATION or send a file with CFCONTENT are never cached. Use ACTION="FLUSH" after you update the data a cached page shows.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- ?flush=yes deletes the cached copy and comes back here --->
<CFIF IsDefined("URL.flush")>
  <CFCACHE ACTION="FLUSH" DIRECTORY="#GetTempDirectory()#" EXPIREURL="#CGI.SCRIPT_NAME#">
  <CFLOCATION URL="cfcache.cfm" ADDTOKEN="No">
</CFIF>
<!--- Serve a saved copy if it is less than one minute old --->
<CFCACHE ACTION="CACHE" DIRECTORY="#GetTempDirectory()#" TIMEOUT="#DateAdd('n', -1, Now())#">

<CFQUERY NAME="Courses" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT CorName, CorLevel FROM CourseList WHERE CorLevel = 'Advanced' ORDER BY CorName
</CFQUERY>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>This page was generated at <B>#TimeFormat(Now(), "HH:mm:ss")#</B>. Reload it: for the next
minute you get the cached copy, and the time does not change.</P>
<UL><CFLOOP QUERY="Courses"><LI>#CorName#</CFLOOP></UL>
<P><A HREF="cfcache.cfm?flush=yes">Flush the cache</A></P>
</CFOUTPUT>
